mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are looking at overcast skies at Verona Community Park. The moon is in a Waning Gibbous phase. If you are awake early tomorrow, the ISS will be visible starting at 3:29 AM, rising in the northwest near Verona High School and traveling toward the northeast near Home Depot.

Verona has two important updates. First, September is designated as Hunger Action Month to support those facing food insecurity. Second, expect traffic delays on Highway M this Monday and Tuesday as crews perform utility work with flaggers on-site.

There is plenty to do today, including the Verona Area Kids Triathlon, live music at Bailey's Run, live music at Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Girls Try Hockey at the Verona Ice Arena. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga tomorrow at Insight Wellness.

In a noteworthy call from August 22, officers responded to a vehicle accident on Enterprise Drive where a driver was cited for several infractions, including inattentive driving and operating after revocation.
Today is the perfect day to stop by Culver's for their Flavor of the Day, which is Crazy for Cookie Dough. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM.
